string.text: Sea Raiders & Pirates
Bandit Party Size Multiplier
Adjusts the size of all bandit parties. Only newly spawned parties are affected. High values may decrease performance and may have negative influence on game experience. [Default: 1.00]
Desert Bandit Party Size Multiplier
Scales desert bandit party sizes. Applies to newly spawned parties. [Default: 0.60]

Bandit Party Size Limit (affects Movement Speed)

While it does not make the bandit party's troops desert, being over the limit slows down the party. A higher limit lessens or removes the malus, increasing movement speed. (The party slows down if it has more troops than the size limit.) Requires reloading! [Default: 20]

Maximum Parties around Hideout
Maximum number of faction-parties around hideouts. [Default: 8]
Maximum Parties in Hideout
[Default: 4]
Maximum Troop Count in First Fight - Factor
Actual count depends on number of troops in hideout and player progress (lowest maximum is 12 with player progress at 0). Set to 0 for unlimited. [Default: 1.0]
Maximum Troop Count in Boss Fight - Factor
Actual count depends on number of troops in hideout and player progress (lowest maximum is 6 with player progress at 0). Set to 0 for unlimited. [Default: 1.0]
Spawn Percentage in First Fight
Percentage of troops to be spawned in the initial fight before the boss battle. [Default: 75%]

Enable Logging
Writes debug info to %USERPROFILE%\Documents\Mount and Blade II Bannerlord\Configs\ModLogs\AdjustableBandits.log. [Default: Off]
Reset settings from defaults JSON
Loads values from ModuleData/adjustablebandits.defaults.json and applies them. Reopen MCM to view refreshed values.
